basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old based in Portland, Oregon, working as a junior environmental consultant. I recently transitioned from warehouse work, which took a toll on my body. I have a deep interest in renewable energy and often explore poetry as a creative outlet. My online hours are mostly in the evenings after work, and I enjoy engaging with communities that discuss sustainable living and creative writing. I'm single and often spend my weekends hiking in the beautiful Oregon wilderness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and recently completed a certification in renewable energy technologies. My passion for poetry is self-taught, honed through reading and participating in online poetry communities. My knowledge is a blend of formal education and personal exploration.
